sentences.text:
Applicant :- Ajay
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Pratap Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Vijay Pratap Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Manoj Kumar, learned AGA for the State-respondent.
3. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
154 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323, 506 IPC & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Knowledge Park, District Gautam Budh Nagar, during pendency of the trial in the court below.
4.

FIR of the present case was lodged on 2.8.2024 against the applicant and according to the FIR,
marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the sister of the informant on 24.6.2024 and after marriage, applicant tortured her for Rs. Two lacs and on 6.2.2024 he informed the informant that his sister has died and when informant after receiving information arrived at his home then found that the home of the applicant was locked and thereafter on the way dead body of his sister was found near a canal and applicant was also present there.

Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31560708/
1 5.
It is further mentioned in the FIR that applicant committed the dowry death of the sister of the informant.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that however applicant is husband of the deceased but on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture he has been made accused in the present matter.
7.

He further submitted that admittedly deceased died on 6.2.2024 and immediately thereafter applicant informed the informant and informant immediately after receiving the information arrived but in spite of that he lodged the FIR of the present case on 2.8.2024 i.e. after six months and this inordinate delay of six months in lodging the FIR clearly suggests that FIR is based of false and fabricated facts.
8.

He further submitted that actually informant borrowed money from the applicant and he wanted that applicant also gave him further money but applicant was unable to give any further money to him and only due to this reason informant pressurized his sister i.e. wife of the applicant and due to this reason she hanged herself and after her death on the basis of false allegation applicant has been made accused in the present matter.
9. He further submitted that post mortem report also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.

10. He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 9.8.2024.
11.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that FIR of the present case was lodged after six months and deceased died due to hanging.
12. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

13. However, applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and torture but FIR of the present case was lodged after six months.

14. Further, post mortem report suggests that deceased died due to hanging, therefore, prima facie,
it appears to be a case of suicidal death.
15. Further, applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 9.8.2024.

16. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31560708/
2 17.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

18. Let the applicant-Ajay, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
19. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

20. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 10.12.2024 Ankita  Ajay vs State Of U.P. on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31560708/
